_meta.status: FINAL — all 8 owner questions answered 2026-07-07 (see proposal doc 'Owner answers' section). Ready to apply via tools/apply_family_taxonomy.py.
_meta.apply_path: A one-shot tool tools/apply_family_taxonomy.py reads this file, mutates the in-memory parts_db doc, and persists via save_config_file (cloud-safe). Neither the Hierarchy editor (no families/family_id UI) nor tools/curate.py (no family op) can apply this today — see proposal doc section 'Apply path'. Additive schema support (families top-level + part_type.family_id) must land first; both are optional keys so existing validation stays green.
invariants: Additive only: no part_type is deleted, no home/fits_part_types changes, no product touched.
part_type.category is PRESERVED during migration (the picker still reads it) until the picker is switched to read family_id + picker_flow; see proposal 'Migration safety'.
Families are orthogonal to the three axes (category=type_id / zone / build-section). A family may span type_ids; membership is single (a part_type sits under at most one family).
Accessory part_types (accessory_of set, or the generic bracket/cable/flange/lighthead/shroud homes) are NOT browse leaves and are NOT given a family_id — they surface via the accessory mechanism.

task1_type_id_corrections.why: Owner rule: a center console is stationary metal furniture bolted into the vehicle = structural. Things that MOUNT to the console (armrest, faceplate, pedestal, dock, swing arm, 12v ports) stay equipment. 31 products homed here; type flip is metadata-only (no home/product change).
OQ-7, owner answer 2026-07-07: GTT/Opticom signal-preemption emitter is an electronic transmitter, not an emergency light. Audit sec 3.5 already flagged it. Owner approved the flip to equipment.

task1_owner_questions_no_change_applied.why: OQ-8, owner answer 2026-07-07: defer. Generic accessory homes nominally typed 'lights' but they hold camera/tool/equipment/structural accessories too. Leave type_id untouched until the accessory-browse surface is designed; do not treat as lights-only.
A mount/storage box (furniture-like) vs a gear-mounting system. Leave equipment pending owner call.
Fuse modules / breakers / install wiring are electrical, closer to equipment than 'extras'. Cosmetic; leave pending owner call.

task1_owner_questions_no_change_applied.candidate: keep, but flasher-in-warning is an oddity
task1_owner_questions_no_change_applied.why: Flasher modules are electronics with no color, yet carry category=warning. Kept as-is to preserve today's behavior; flagged for a later revisit. No change applied.

warning_lights.label: Warning
warning_lights.why: Migrated verbatim from today's part_type.category=='warning' so the picker's warning color flow is unchanged. Kind-group (by lighting kind), grandfathered into the one families mechanism.

scene_lights.label: Scene
scene_lights.why: Migrated from category=='scene' (spotlight also carries category=scene). Preserves the scene no-color-filter flow.

roof_bars.label: Roof Bars
roof_bars.why: Migrated from category=='roof_bar'. Single member; keeps the lightbar Setup/Edition panel entry.

radar.label: Radar
radar.why: Owner example. A radar install is always specified as one system: display unit + 1-2 antennas + their mounts + cabling. The antenna mounts are already accessory_of radar_display_unit — strong corroboration they belong together.

radio_comms.label: Radio Communications
radio_comms.why: Owner example ('radio'). A two-way radio install = head + speaker + cable + mic clip + antenna cable, specified together. radio_antenna_top deliberately EXCLUDED (shared roof antenna; 'don't group all antennas'). pa_mic / pa_mic_clip deliberately EXCLUDED pending the PA-belongs-to-radio-or-siren ruling (owner question OQ-3).

camera_system.label: Camera System
camera_system.why: Owner example ('camera equipment'). In-car video = DVR + front/rear/seat cameras, one system. (Cameras are often unbilled/agency-supplied but still browse together.)

light_control_system.label: Light Control System
light_control_system.why: Owner example verbatim: 'core, external amp, expansion modules, cloud, vehicle-sync'. Map: core->control_head, external amp->external_amp, expansion modules->expansion_module, cloud->cloud_system_tray + cloud_antenna, vehicle-sync->v2v_sync. Label kept brand-neutral (control heads may be Whelen/Feniex/SoundOff) per OQ-4 owner answer. OQ-5 owner answer 2026-07-07: light_controller (trunk module) ADDED as a 7th member. photo_eye stays a product-level accessory of the Core (not a family member). power_timer (ChargeGuard) stays bare — it's the alternative to a Core, not a co-installed member.

computer_workstation.label: Computer Workstation
computer_workstation.why: Owner example ('computer + docking station'). Explicitly does NOT include console (owner: computer goes IN the console = location, not belonging). pedestal_mount left bare (shared console/computer base) — see OQ-6.

thermal_imaging.label: Thermal Imaging
thermal_imaging.why: Thermal camera + its dedicated monitor are specified together (same spirit as 'camera equipment').

push_bumper_system.label: Push Bumper System
push_bumper_system.why: Owner example verbatim: 'push bumper + pit bar + wing wraps + wire covers + Westin light bracket'. The Westin light bracket is NOT a part_type — per ruling C1.2 it is a PRODUCT-level accessory of push_bumper (Westin light tubes = push-bumper accessories). It stays discoverable through this family. FUTURE (captured, not built): the in-product-box 'add other bumper parts?' flow reads this family's members + push_bumper's product-level accessories.
linked_product_accessories: Westin light bracket / light tubes (accessory_of push_bumper product, per C1.2)

console_system.label: Console System
console_system.why: OQ-2 owner answer 2026-07-07: console + motion_attachment (swing arm) ONLY. arm_rest, special_face_plate, pedestal_mount, and aux_12v_ports mount TO the console (location), so they are left bare rather than included as members — see task2_deliberately_ungrouped.

task2_deliberately_ungrouped.why: printer_mount/power/usb are already accessory_of printer — pure accessories, surfaced when you add a printer. A Printer family would duplicate the accessory mechanism. Left as accessory-only (demonstrates family selectivity). Revisit only if printers need independent browse.
siren_speaker_bracket is accessory_of siren_speaker. Siren is driven by the control head but is not always co-specified as one unit; leave siren_speaker bare.
OQ-3 owner answer 2026-07-07: bare. Not radio_comms, no PA family for now. radio_comms stays as-is (5 members, PA excluded).
Shared roof antenna (radio + GPS + modem). 'Don't group all antennas.' Bare under Equipment.
gun_lock_bracket is accessory_of gun_lock. One primary + accessory; no sibling system. Bare (gun_lock) + accessory.
OQ-2 owner answer 2026-07-07: these mount TO the console (location), not belong to it as a system. Left bare rather than added to Console System.
OQ-6 owner answer 2026-07-07: bare. Shared base for console AND computer; belongs cleanly to neither Console System nor Computer Workstation.
Standalone equipment part_types with no belong-together sibling system. Bare under their category. photo_eye and power_timer resolved via OQ-5 (see light_control_system).

task3_browse.note: tree_positions is NO LONGER read by the sidebar. It remains on part_types as data (sku_grid filters + schema validation still use it) and location survives as placement metadata (location_mode / location_options / placements / zones) for the preview drawing + build-sheet location text.
task3_browse.hierarchy: category (type_id) -> family (optional) -> part_type. See proposal doc section 3 for the full before/after tree.
